title: L1: surface hidden coupling in orient output
description: Add a hidden_coupling section to orient's per-component output. For each component, show file pairs that are behaviorally coupled (high co-change Jaccard) but have no static import edge — "these files are coupled but not by imports." Depends on the commit_files table and co-change infrastructure from sutra/67.

acceptance_criteria.text: Orient output includes a hidden_coupling key per component section
Each entry shows the file pair, Jaccard coefficient, and shared commit count
Only pairs above the configured cochange_threshold are included

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review — verdict: needs-attention

[medium] Hidden coupling filter uses import_edges only, not full resolved-reference graph (shared with sutra/82)
Orient's hidden_coupling_for_component filters pairs using only import_edges. Clustering defines static edges from resolved symbol refs (not just imports), so call/use refs without an import row are treated as "hidden" here but are already statically linked for clustering purposes. Recommend building the exclusion set from the same resolved-reference graph used by clustering.
